summary: Added a `show_speed` parameter to `TaskProgressColumn` in rich/progress.py (default False). When enabled and the task has no total, the column renders speed as "N.N it/s", with k/M/G/T suffixes at 1000 and above, using finished_speed or speed. Otherwise the existing format is used. Nothing was run, since tests and scripts were off-limits, so the change is verified by reading only. Nothing was committed. Open choices: speed uses the progress.percentage style, and the class docstring was not updated.
